scenes.caption: attunr
scenes.text: attunr gives you a practice plan for every day, for guitar, singing, and ear and theory. Each exercise in it plays with you and listens to you. It runs in your browser.

scenes.caption: A few questions
scenes.text: It starts with a few questions: what you play or sing, where you are with it, and how many minutes a day you have. Your first plan is made from the answers.

scenes.caption: Today's plan
scenes.text: Open the practice plan, and today is ready: a few short exercises, each with its minutes. They come from a library of exercises, and each day is a bit different from the day before.

cues.different: each day is a bit different

scenes.caption: Exercises
scenes.text: Every exercise has its tool on the page. A guitar neck shows the notes to play. A tab scrolls along as you play. The staff draws your voice as you sing. A backing track plays under you.

scenes.caption: Rate it
scenes.text: After each exercise you rate how it went, from Can't do it yet to Easy now. The next plan is made from those ratings. It brings in the next step, and mixes back a little of what is already solid.

scenes.caption: Every day
scenes.text: A reminder comes at the time you choose. A timer runs for the day's practice, and the day streak counts the days you practise. There are no points and no score.

scenes.caption: attunr
scenes.text: A plan for today, exercises that play along, and a next step made from your ratings. That is attunr.

scenes.caption: attunr
scenes.text: attunr is a web app for music teachers. You give each student a week of practice, follow them along a learning path, and see how every exercise went.

scenes.caption: Add a student
scenes.text: Add a student by name and email, and answer a few questions about what they play and where they are. The student gets a link by email, and their first week is ready.

scenes.caption: A week of practice
scenes.text: Each week is seven days of short exercises, picked for that student from a library of exercises. You choose the days they practise. Every exercise says exactly what to play: this scale, in this key, in this position.

scenes.caption: Learning path
scenes.text: The learning path lays out every skill as steps, from New to Advanced. Your student is drawn on it. Green steps are solid, amber steps are being worked on, and the rest is still ahead.

scenes.caption: Progress
scenes.text: Every rating goes into the student's progress, skill by skill, with the days and minutes practised. From it, each plan picks the steps within reach. What is solid comes back now and then, and what is far ahead waits.

scenes.caption: The next week
scenes.text: You stay the teacher. You see how each exercise went for the student, and you move a slider for each topic to where you hear them now. Press Make next week's plan, and the next week follows both.

scenes.caption: attunr
scenes.text: A week to practise, a path to follow, and progress you can read, for every student. That is attunr for teachers.
